answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, expired if not renewed by fresh work. Reaching the onyx of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Work waits on the jade until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the trellis of the next round.
